_comment: Copy this file as fact_base.json. Delete the _example facts and the _comment keys; replace meta. Schema reference: references/fact-base-schema.md. Every report number must exist here with a source. meta.decision_critical lists the headline facts the audit requires to carry >=2 cross_checked_with entries (opt-in --strict-verified extends the rule to every Verified fact). Round 3: consensus-side facts carry consensus_provider/consensus_vintage (+contributor_count) and a T1/T2 source_tier; Reasoned facts declare epistemic_kind derived|judged (judged allocations may carry signed weights + realized_move, which the WATERFALL gate sums); an IC-named meta.audience requires meta.mandate_context (fund_position + position_as_of). Round 4 (reports 8/9): consensus facts also carry consensus_statistic mean|median|undisclosed; when meta.t1_filing_timestamp is set, every fact declares data_type pre_event_input|post_event_fact (post-event facts must be retrieved at/after the filing time — TEMPORAL gate).

meta.subject: COMPANY Inc. (NASDAQ: TICK)
meta.event: EVENT NAME (e.g. Q3 FY2026 earnings release + conference call)
meta.t1_filing_timestamp: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS-04:00 (verified T1 filing/publication time — pins the TEMPORAL gate; omit to leave it silent)
meta.reaction_definition: event-window rule: after-close event -> T+1 full-session close (YYYY-MM-DD); pre-market/intraday event -> T+0 close (YYYY-MM-DD)

mandate_context.mandate_constraints: e.g. single-name cap 5%; no leverage (or 'none declared')

hypotheses.lens: (a) revenue miss | (b) margin/EPS | (c) segment | (d) guidance | (e) capital allocation | (f) structural narrative | (g) positioning+macro | (h) one-off noise | (i) market microstructure & flow
hypotheses.verdict: PRIMARY — narrative | PRIMARY — mechanical | CONTRIBUTOR | AMPLIFIER | NOISE | EXCLUDED (fill in Phase 4)

facts._example_3: DELETE ME — consensus-side fact pattern (round 3): provider + vintage + T1/T2 tier are mandatory; the consensus is the denominator of every beat/miss delta
facts.source_name: LSEG consensus as reported by Reuters (named outlet + date)
facts.consensus_vintage: YYYY-MM-DD (within 1–3 trading days of the event; gate default 5 calendar days)
facts.consensus_statistic: mean | median | undisclosed (record which statistic the provider prints)
cross_checked_with: Visible Alpha as reported by CNBC (second origination chain)

facts._example_4: DELETE ME — judged-allocation fact pattern (round 3): signed weights must sum to realized_move (WATERFALL gate); explicitly non-causal
facts.metric: Driver decomposition of the session move (judged allocation)

facts.source_name: Company earnings call transcript (Motley Fool) / SEC 10-Q
facts.quote: Exact source sentence when the fact will be quoted or paraphrased
